name: Wind Barbs
description: Weather-map wind barbs turned to a smooth wind field, the barbs on each staff counting the speed and tinted warmer where it blows hardest.

code.style: --rule: ( @random(${shapeFrequency}) { --a: @rn(-60, 240); --s: @rn(-0.5, 1.5, 1.6); -webkit-transform: rotate($deg(a)); transform: rotate($deg(a)); :before { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12%; top: 47%; width: 76%; height: 6%; background: @p(var(--color1)); border-radius: 99px; -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } :after { content: ''; position: absolute; left: 12%; top: 19%; width: 30%; height: 31%; background: @match($(s) < 0.34, @p(var(--color2)), $(s) < 0.67, @p(var(--color3)), @p(var(--color4))); -webkit-mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 16%, transparent 16% 36%, #000 36% 52%, transparent 52% 72%, #000 72% 88%, transparent 88%); mask: linear-gradient(90deg, #000 0 16%, transparent 16% 36%, #000 36% 52%, transparent 52% 72%, #000 72% 88%, transparent 88%); -webkit-clip-path: inset(0 @calc(86 - 36 * floor(max(0, min(2, $(s) * 3))))% 0 0); clip-path: inset(0 @calc(86 - 36 * floor(max(0, min(2, $(s) * 3))))% 0 0); -webkit-transform-origin: 0 100%; transform-origin: 0 100%; -webkit-transform: skewX(-28deg); transform: skewX(-28deg); -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; } } -webkit-transition: ease 450ms; transition: ease 450ms; );
code.doodle: :doodle { @grid: ${grid}; @size: ${width} ${height}; overflow:hidden; text-align:center; box-sizing:border-box; } :container { background: var(--color0); overflow:hidden; }
